text: Gold slipped about 0.3% to roughly $4,004, staying just above Friday's three-month low as the Fed meeting begins.
Silver fell about 1.6% to $53.06, much more than gold, so the gold/silver ratio rose to about 75.5.
Brent eased to about $114.80, down nearly 0.9% from Monday's settle, on hopes that talks with Iran calm Gulf supply risks.
US stock futures pointed slightly higher, with Nasdaq-100 futures up about 0.3%, after Monday's tech-led bounce.
Treasury yields barely moved: the 10-year sat near 4.98% and the 2-year near 4.71%.
The yen weakened slightly to about 157.7 per dollar ahead of the Fed on Wednesday and the Bank of Japan on Friday.
Bitcoin edged down about 0.5% to around $79,450.
